children: SeaStar Medical executed financing steps tied to a warrant exercise offering. The company entered letter agreements on October 2, 2026 that induced cash exercise of 854,002 prior warrants at $3.866 per share, generating roughly $3.3 million in gross proceeds, and issued new Series A and Series B warrants totaling up to 1,708,004 shares at a $3.616 exercise price. Separately, SeaStar Medical engaged H.C. Wainwright as exclusive placement agent, agreeing to customary fees and issuing 59,780 placement agent warrants at $4.8325 per share. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, with agreed limitations on new issuances and variable-rate transactions for defined periods.
